disposition.reason: The pinned report reproduces 26 violations among 60 checked firings while its three retained violation rows contain replay metadata and grid previews only.
disposition.recommended_change: When a witness fires and every named rival agrees with authority, retain a complete source-bound artifact with the input, canonical output, agreeing rival names and outputs, recipe, validation, and source hashes. Reuse the existing semantic-witness artifact schema where practical.
recommended_tests: a violated WITNESS_RIVALS claim retains full input/authority/rival grids
the retained artifact binds generator, rule source, and callable hashes
BRANCH_WITNESSES remains descriptive and produces no separation failure
disposition.summary: Keep the automatic violation-artifact requirement, but do not add a parallel relation-type API: WITNESS_RIVALS already expresses exact separation and BRANCH_WITNESSES already expresses descriptive branch coverage.

limits: Retained source-bound evidence was inspected once; no new broad semantic census was run.
This disposition does not approve the proposal for runtime selection or training admission.
